verdict.rationale: The pack contains no first-party documentation of participant recording notifications, in-meeting disclosure prompts, or admin-enforced transparency controls. The nearest items don't count: audit logs and SSO are adjacent admin features, and the bot-free desktop recording claim points away from disclosure. Community reports describe participants learning of recording only from a post-meeting summary email, which is an output-sharing default rather than a consent feature.

support.subject: As an IT admin, the product ships real consent features — participant notifications, in-meeting disclosure, or admin-enforced transparency — not just a policy PDF
